findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: When a user's tenant differs from the document's tenant, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. Any read path relying on this authorization function therefore permits cross-tenant document disclosure.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant matching before granting document access
findings.body:
When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, this now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document reads and bypassing tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported document label contract
findings.body:
Consumers expecting the established exact value `"Document"`—such as serializers, lookup tables, or strict assertions—now receive `"Document record"`, breaking the exported data contract.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
Any user whose tenant differs from the document tenant now passes this authorization check, enabling cross-tenant document disclosure whenever this function gates reads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
